finalText:
**Build's clean now.** Exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both in the link stage, from the same bundler bump:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) — read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to use `retryCount`.
- [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`, since the new config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest of the noise (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, circular-import warning, etc.) is unrelated deprecation chatter from the bump, 8 warnings total, all pre-existing and harmless.
